# 会话管理 · Session Manager **为 Google Antigravity 打造的会话归档 / 检索 / 预览 / 导出面板** 五大视图 · 全文检索 · 免恢复预览 · 批量归档（可撤回） · 标签与备注 · Markdown 导出 · 四种界面语言 [**简体中文**](./README.md) · [**English**](./README.en.md) · [**繁體中文**](./README.zh-TW.md) · [**日本語**](./README.ja.md) · [**更新日志**](./CHANGELOG.md) · [**版本发布**](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/releases) · [**问题反馈**](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/issues)

主图由 tools/render-hero.mjs 直接渲染本仓库面板源码，亮 / 暗版本跟随 GitHub 主题切换；会话内容均为虚构示例。
> **非官方社区项目声明 (Non-Affiliation Disclaimer)** > > 本项目为独立的开源社区插件，与 Google LLC 无任何隶属、赞助或官方背书关系；文中提及的 “Antigravity” 与 “Google” 仅用于说明兼容性。 --- ## ✨ 亮点 - **五大视图，一眼分清**：活跃、已归档、收藏、闲置、全部。打开面板时默认显示活跃会话。 - **什么都搜得到**：标题、项目、正文、标签、备注一起全文检索，命中处高亮。 - **不恢复也能看**：直接预览历史对话，超长消息自动折叠，排版视图和原文视图一键切换。 - **归档后悔了？撤回**：支持批量归档 / 恢复、按闲置天数一键归档，操作都能撤回。 - **整理顺手**：置顶 📌、星标 ★、`#标签`、自动保存的备注、原地重命名。 - **一键导出 Markdown**：连同会话信息、标签和备注一起导出到 `~/Documents/Antigravity-Exports`。 - **四种界面语言**：可切换简体中文、English、繁體中文或日本語。面板会记住所选语言，配色跟随宿主主题。 - **安全兜底**：运行中的会话禁止删除，SQLite 只读打开，本地备注原子保存。 --- ## 🖼️ 界面预览 ### 1. 主面板与超长消息折叠 活跃视图下，琥珀色「归档」按钮随手可点；单条超过 450px 的消息自动折叠，附带渐隐遮罩和「展开全文 / 收起」。

### 2. 已归档视图与全文检索高亮 在已归档视图中检索，命中词高亮显示；Markdown 预览可展开阅读，绿色「恢复」一键放回活跃视图。

### 3. 功能速查表 | 场景 | 操作 | 入口 | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 找旧会话 | 原文片段 / 多关键词检索，配合项目 / 分组 / 标签筛选与排序 | 面板顶部 | | 归档 / 恢复 | 琥珀色「归档」/ 绿色「恢复」，可撤回 | 会话卡片、预览工具栏 | | 批量处理 | 多选后归档或恢复，在已归档视图可确认永久删除所选会话 | 「批量」按钮 | | 清理闲置 | 按 3 / 7 / 14 / 30 天批量归档闲置会话 | 闲置视图 | | 阅读长会话 | 展开全部 / 全部折叠、⬆ 顶部、⬇ 底部、排版 / 原文 | 预览工具栏 | | 整理 | 置顶、星标、重命名、`#标签`、备注 | 卡片与预览区 | | 导出 | 导出 `.md`，可定位文件或打开导出目录 | 预览工具栏、「导出目录」 | | 打开面板 | 左侧栏入口（需 CDP）/ 右侧插件菜单 / 对话指令 | 多处 | --- ## 🚀 快速安装 ### 方式一：安装脚本（推荐 · 普通用户） **Windows (PowerShell)：** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git cd agy-archive-manager .\scripts\install.ps1 ``` **macOS / Linux：** ```bash git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git cd agy-archive-manager chmod +x scripts/install.sh ./scripts/install.sh ``` 再次运行同一脚本即可更新到仓库中的最新版本。 ### 方式二：手动复制（开发者 / 离线环境） 将以下文件复制到 `~/.gemini/config/plugins/archive-manager/`（Windows 为 `%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\archive-manager\`）： - `plugin.json`、`logo.svg`、`LICENSE` - `README.md`、`README.en.md`、`README.zh-TW.md`、`README.ja.md`、`CHANGELOG.md` - `docs/screenshots/`（文档预览图） - `skills/`、`sidecars/` 安装完成后，在 Antigravity 的 **Customizations → Plugins** 中启用 **会话管理 (Session Manager)**，即可在右侧辅助面板打开，或在对话中说「打开会话管理面板」。 ### 让 AI 助手代装 使用 Antigravity Agent、Claude Code、Cursor 等 AI 助手安装时，可直接让它执行以下步骤： ```bash git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git cd agy-archive-manager # 1. 运行对应系统的安装脚本（Windows 用 .\scripts\install.ps1） ./scripts/install.sh # 2. 确认 Sidecar 运行时支持 node:sqlite（应输出 function） node -e "import('node:sqlite').then(m => console.log(typeof m.DatabaseSync))" ``` 然后提醒用户在 **Customizations → Plugins** 中启用插件。 --- ## 🆕 v2.3.1 - 「活跃」成为首个视图，打开面板时默认显示全部未归档会话。 - 新增繁體中文和日本語。界面、操作提示及 Markdown 导出的固定字段随所选语言切换。 - GitHub README 新增繁體中文版和日文版。 [查看完整更新日志](./CHANGELOG.md) --- ## ❓ 常见问题
左侧栏没有出现「会话管理」入口？ 左侧栏入口和归档角标依赖 Chrome DevTools Protocol（CDP），需要用 `--remote-debugging-port=0` 启动 Antigravity。不开启也没关系，右侧插件菜单和对话指令都能打开面板。
面板打不开，或者提示 node:sqlite 相关错误？ Sidecar 通过 `node` 命令启动，要求 Antigravity 实际使用的 Node.js 默认启用 `node:sqlite`，例如 Node.js 22.13+（22.x LTS）或 Node.js 24 LTS。可以用上面「让 AI 助手代装」中的命令自检。
预览只显示了一部分消息？ 预览优先读取 `transcript_full.jsonl`，可用时结合 `transcript.jsonl`；两者都缺失时回退到 FTS 摘要。较早的会话如果没有留下完整转录，就只能看到部分消息或摘要，面板会给出提示。
Antigravity 更新后功能异常？ 归档等操作通过 Antigravity 内部的 `ConversationService` 完成，检索与预览读取内部数据文件，宿主更新可能改变这些接口。请附上 Antigravity 版本号到 [Issues](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/issues) 反馈。
导出的 Markdown 文件在哪里？标签和备注存在哪里？ 导出文件保存在 `~/Documents/Antigravity-Exports`，每次导出生成独立文件，面板里可以一键定位。面板通过宿主服务更新原生标签，并读回核对。备注与旧版本留下的本地标签记录保存在 Sidecar 数据目录。Antigravity 2.35.2 可能忽略清空最后一个标签的请求，面板会读回核对，未生效时提示并保留本地记录。
---
🔧 运行要求与数据来源（点击展开） - **Google Antigravity**：设计目标为 Antigravity 2.35.0。面板和进程生命周期使用公开的 Sidecar 机制，参见 [Antigravity Sidecar 文档](https://antigravity.google/docs/sidecars/)。 - **会话数据**：归档等操作通过内部 `ConversationService` 提交；搜索和预览读取内部 SQLite 摘要索引和转录文件，其中 SQLite 以只读方式打开。Antigravity 更新可能改变这些接口和数据格式。 - **Node.js**：Sidecar 启动命令是 `node`，要求 Antigravity 实际启动的 Node.js 默认启用 `node:sqlite`，例如 Node.js 22.13+（22.x LTS 分支）或 Node.js 24 LTS。详见 [Node.js SQLite 文档](https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html)。 - **左侧栏快捷入口（可选）**：入口和归档角标依赖 Antigravity 的界面结构和 CDP，使用时以 `--remote-debugging-port=0` 启动 Antigravity。
📁 目录结构、回归测试与主图渲染（点击展开） #### 目录结构 ```text agy-archive-manager/ ├── plugin.json # 插件清单与元信息 ├── agy-market.json # AGY Market 市场伴随配置 ├── logo.svg # 插件图标 ├── README*.md # 四语说明文档 ├── CHANGELOG.md # 更新日志 ├── LICENSE # MIT 开源协议 ├── docs/ │ ├── benchmark-v2.3.0.md # v2.3.0 历史库基准测试报告 │ └── screenshots/ # 主图与界面预览截图 ├── scripts/ │ ├── install.ps1 # Windows 一键安装 / 更新脚本 │ └── install.sh # macOS / Linux 一键安装 / 更新脚本 ├── skills/ │ └── archive-manager/ │ └── SKILL.md # 对话唤醒技能定义 ├── sidecars/ │ └── archive_manager/ │ ├── sidecar.json # Sidecar 进程与面板入口配置 │ ├── server.mjs # 本地 HTTP + ConversationService 后端 │ ├── server-locale.mjs # 后端提示与 Markdown 导出文案 │ ├── search.mjs # 检索调度与取消控制 │ ├── search-worker.mjs # FTS5 / 流式正文检索工作线程 │ ├── sidebar_injector.mjs # 左侧栏快捷入口注入器（可选 CDP） │ └── index.html # 前端双栏管理面板 ├── tools/ │ ├── benchmark-history.mjs # 万条历史库性能基准脚本 │ └── render-hero.mjs # README 亮 / 暗主图渲染脚本 └── test/ # 本地回归测试套件 ``` #### 本地回归测试 测试使用 Node.js 22.15+（22.x LTS 分支）或 Node.js 24 LTS，在仓库根目录运行： ```sh node --test ``` 测试仅使用模拟的 Antigravity 服务和临时会话数据。 #### 重新渲染主图 面板 UI 改动后，可用本机的 Chrome 或 Edge 重新生成 `docs/screenshots/hero-{light,dark}.png`： ```sh node tools/render-hero.mjs # 找不到浏览器时手动指定： node tools/render-hero.mjs --browser "/path/to/chrome" ```
--- ## 📄 开源协议 本项目基于 [MIT License](./LICENSE) 开源。欢迎通过 [Issues](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/issues) 和 [Pull Requests](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/pulls) 一起打磨。

# Session Manager · 会话管理 **Archive, search, preview, and export your Google Antigravity conversations** Five views · Full-text search · Preview without restoring · Batch archive with undo · Tags & notes · Markdown export · Four interface languages [**简体中文**](./README.md) · [**English**](./README.en.md) · [**繁體中文**](./README.zh-TW.md) · [**日本語**](./README.ja.md) · [**Changelog**](./CHANGELOG.md) · [**Releases**](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/releases) · [**Issues**](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/issues)

Rendered from this repository's panel source by tools/render-hero.mjs. The light and dark versions follow your GitHub theme. All conversations shown are fictional.
> **Non-Affiliation Disclaimer** > > This is an independent open-source community plugin. It is not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Google LLC. “Antigravity” and “Google” are mentioned only to describe compatibility. --- ## ✨ Highlights - **Five views at a glance**: Active, Archived, Starred, Idle, and All, each with a count. The panel opens on Active. - **Find anything**: Search titles, projects, message bodies, tags, and notes at once, with highlighted matches. - **Read without restoring**: Preview past conversations directly. Long replies collapse automatically, and you can switch between formatted and raw views. - **Changed your mind? Undo**: Archive or restore in batches, archive idle conversations by days inactive, and undo the result. - **Stay organized**: Pin 📌, star ★, add `#tags`, keep auto-saved notes, and rename inline. - **One-click Markdown export**: Export conversations with their metadata, tags, and notes to `~/Documents/Antigravity-Exports`. - **Four interface languages**. Choose Simplified Chinese, English, Traditional Chinese, or Japanese. The panel remembers your choice and follows the host theme. - **Safe by default**: Running conversations cannot be deleted, SQLite is opened read-only, and local notes are saved atomically. --- ## 🖼️ Screenshots ### 1. Main panel and long-reply collapsing In the Active view, the amber **Archive** button is always within reach. Replies taller than 450px collapse with a fade overlay and an **Expand / Collapse** toggle.

### 2. Archived view and search highlighting Search inside the Archived view to see highlighted matches, expand the Markdown preview, and use the green **Restore** button to bring a conversation back.

### 3. Feature cheat sheet | Task | Action | Where | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Find an old conversation | Exact text or Keywords search, filter by project / group / tag, and sort | Top of the panel | | Archive / restore | Amber **Archive** / green **Restore**, with undo | Cards, preview toolbar | | Work in bulk | Select chats to archive or restore. Archived chats can also be permanently deleted after confirmation | **Batch** button | | Clean up idle conversations | Archive conversations idle for 3 / 7 / 14 / 30 days | Idle view | | Read long conversations | Expand All / Collapse All, ⬆ Top, ⬇ Bottom, Formatted / Raw | Preview toolbar | | Organize | Pin, star, rename, `#tags`, notes | Cards and preview | | Export | Save as `.md`, reveal the file, or open the export folder | Preview toolbar, **📂 Exports** | | Open the panel | Left-sidebar entry (CDP) / Plugins menu / chat prompt | Several places | --- ## 🚀 Quick Start ### Option 1: Install scripts (recommended for most users) **Windows (PowerShell):** ```powershell git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git cd agy-archive-manager .\scripts\install.ps1 ``` **macOS / Linux:** ```bash git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git cd agy-archive-manager chmod +x scripts/install.sh ./scripts/install.sh ``` Run the same script again to update to the latest version in your clone. ### Option 2: Manual copy (developers / offline) Copy these files into `~/.gemini/config/plugins/archive-manager/` (`%USERPROFILE%\.gemini\config\plugins\archive-manager\` on Windows): - `plugin.json`, `logo.svg`, `LICENSE` - `README.md`, `README.en.md`, `README.zh-TW.md`, `README.ja.md`, `CHANGELOG.md` - `docs/screenshots/` (images used in the READMEs) - `skills/`, `sidecars/` Then enable **Session Manager (`archive-manager`)** under **Customizations → Plugins**. Open it from the side panel, or ask the agent to “Open Session Manager”. ### Installing with an AI assistant If you use Antigravity Agent, Claude Code, Cursor, or another AI assistant, ask it to run: ```bash git clone https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager.git cd agy-archive-manager # 1. Run the install script for your OS (.\scripts\install.ps1 on Windows) ./scripts/install.sh # 2. Check that the Sidecar runtime supports node:sqlite (should print "function") node -e "import('node:sqlite').then(m => console.log(typeof m.DatabaseSync))" ``` Then remind the user to enable the plugin under **Customizations → Plugins**. --- ## 🆕 What's New in v2.3.1 - Active is the first tab. The panel opens with all unarchived conversations. - Traditional Chinese and Japanese are available for the interface, operation messages, and Markdown export labels. - The GitHub README is now available in Traditional Chinese and Japanese. [See the full changelog](./CHANGELOG.md) --- ## ❓ FAQ
The Session Manager entry does not appear in the left sidebar. The left-sidebar entry and archive badge rely on the Chrome DevTools Protocol (CDP). Start Antigravity with `--remote-debugging-port=0`. Without it, you can still open the panel from the Plugins menu or with a chat prompt.
The panel does not open, or I see a node:sqlite error. The Sidecar starts with the `node` command, and that Node.js runtime must enable `node:sqlite` by default, for example Node.js 22.13+ (22.x LTS) or Node.js 24 LTS. Use the check command in “Installing with an AI assistant” above.
The preview only shows some of the messages. The preview prefers `transcript_full.jsonl`, uses `transcript.jsonl` where applicable, and falls back to FTS excerpts when neither is available. Older conversations without full transcripts may show only partial messages or summaries, and the panel tells you when this happens.
Something broke after an Antigravity update. Archive operations use Antigravity's internal `ConversationService`, and search and preview read internal data files, so host updates can change these interfaces. Please open an [issue](https://github.com/YukiKaguraA/agy-archive-manager/issues) with your Antigravity version.
Where are exports, tags, and notes stored? Exports are saved to `~/Documents/Antigravity-Exports`, one file per export, and the panel can reveal them. The panel writes tags through the host service and reads them back to verify the update. Notes and legacy tag overrides are stored in the Sidecar data directory. Antigravity 2.35.2 can ignore a request to clear the last tag. The panel checks whether the change took effect and retains the local record if it did not.

🔧 Requirements and data sources (click to expand) - **Google Antigravity**: Targets Antigravity 2.35.0 and uses publicly documented Sidecar support for the panel and process lifecycle. See the [Antigravity Sidecar documentation](https://antigravity.google/docs/sidecars/). - **Conversation data**: Session operations go through Antigravity's internal `ConversationService`. Search and preview read a SQLite summary index (opened read-only) and transcript files. Antigravity updates can change these interfaces and data formats. - **Node.js**: The Sidecar command is `node`. The Node.js runtime that Antigravity launches must enable `node:sqlite` by default, for example Node.js 22.13+ on the 22.x LTS line or Node.js 24 LTS. See the [Node.js SQLite documentation](https://nodejs.org/api/sqlite.html). - **Left-sidebar quick entry (optional)**: Depends on Antigravity's UI and CDP. Start Antigravity with `--remote-debugging-port=0` to use it.
